chunks: Never so. We have created them from what they know.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says God created humans from what they know?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Mursalat, this verse highlights the paradox of human creation from a known substance (often interpreted by Shia scholars as seminal fluid or the earth), underscoring God's omnipotence in transforming the familiar into the complex. It serves as a rhetorical argument for the Resurrection, suggesting that if God can create from what is known, He can certainly recreate it. This reinforces the Shia theological emphasis on divine power and the tangible reality of the soul's origin.
